result.summary: The image shows a narrow roadway adjacent to a fenced recreational field with a complete lack of pedestrian infrastructure. There are no sidewalks, marked crossings, or street lights, forcing pedestrians to walk on the road or the uneven grassy slope.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian separation
hazards.description: No sidewalk or paved shoulder exists, forcing pedestrians to share the narrow roadway with vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the right side of the image where the road meets the grass.

hazards.name: Lack of crossing infrastructure
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or signage to facilitate safe crossing to the recreational area.

interventions.title: Install Sidewalks
interventions.description: Construct a paved sidewalk along the roadway to provide a dedicated and safe space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalk and Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks and pedestrian crossing warning signs near the entrance to the recreational field.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers during low-light conditions.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly hostile, lacking sidewalks, marked crossings, or any physical separation from vehicular traffic. Pedestrians are forced to walk on unpaved grass shoulders, and the wide, open roadway design likely encourages higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalks
hazards.description: Pedestrians have no dedicated space and must walk on uneven grass or in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the road throughout the view

hazards.name: Lack of Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or signals to facilitate safe crossing of the wide roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: The intersection area in the foreground

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Utility Poles
hazards.description: Large utility poles at the corner may block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install paved sidewalks to provide a safe, dedicated space for pedestrians away from vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility crosswalk markings and pedestrian warning signs to improve driver awareness at the intersection.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Implement measures such as speed humps or narrowing the roadway to reduce vehicle speeds in this institutional area.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly underdeveloped, lacking sidewalks, marked crosswalks, and traffic control devices. Pedestrians are forced to share the roadway with vehicles in an area with wide, unmarked lanes and degraded pavement edges.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Separation
hazards.description: No sidewalks or protected walkways exist, forcing pedestrians to walk directly in the path of vehicular traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the edges of the roadway throughout the scene.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The wide intersection lacks any marked crosswalks or signage to indicate pedestrian priority or presence.
hazards.location_in_image: The center of the intersection where the roads meet.

hazards.name: Degraded Road Edges
hazards.description: The pavement at the road edges is crumbling and uneven, creating trip hazards for anyone walking there.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the foreground roadway.

interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks along the roadway to provide physical separation between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing and Markings
interventions.description: Paint lane lines to define travel lanes and narrow the perceived width of the road to slow traffic.
